data.body: Plan-review remediation evidence (2026-08-17): installed the lock-compatible optional dependency `jira==3.10.5` into this dedicated worktree venv and inspected the runtime API without reading credentials or contacting Jira. `inspect.signature(jira.JIRA.__init__)` exposes top-level `max_retries: int = 3`. Source assigns `self._session.max_retries = max_retries`. A no-network construction probe using `JIRA(server="https://jira.invalid", token_auth="probe", get_server_info=False, max_retries=0)` produced `_session.max_retries == 0`. This confirms the dedicated executor-client mechanism and shows that the existing transport comment about `verify` belonging in the options dict does not apply to `max_retries`. The remediated plan review then certified PASS at origin/main SHA 5b5008bbfbec04cd8c0c9ad2d4b2860ed7d8f652.
